items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Bennie Carter. He had a band it went into the Savoy for a short time. I recorded with him during that time.

ctx.x: Now did you replace Langston Curl in the Cotton Picker's band?
Yes. I replaced Curl. And Bennie Carter and I went at the same time.
Now Bennie Carter was the leader of the band?
